exposure: cesarean hysterectomy due to placenta accreta and massive bleeding
outcome: large pelvic urinoma secondary to right ureter injury
bilateral ovarian and renal veins thrombi
cohort: A 36-year-old female patient who underwent a cesarean hysterectomy.
finding: A 36-year-old female patient developed right flank pain, right hydronephrosis, a large pelvic urinoma secondary to right ureter injury, and bilateral ovarian and renal vein thromboses on day 4 postcesarean hysterectomy.
mod_finding: The described thromboses and urinoma occurred following a cesarean hysterectomy.
